UK 4 Day Week Pilot Results Full Report
UK 4 day week pilot results report - February 2023
This report details the full findings of our largest 4 day working week trial to date, comprising 61 companies and around 2,900 workers, that took place in the UK from June to December 2022. This report was conducting with our partners in this trial - 4 Day Week Campaign UK and Autonomy.
